title: Spaghetti Carbonara
desc: Spaghetti with guanciale, Pecorino and a glossy egg sauce.
steps: Bring water and salt to a boil in a large pot.
Cook spaghetti until just tender. Meanwhile fry guanciale in a large dry pan for 8 minutes until golden; take off the heat.
Whisk pasteurised eggs and yolks with Pecorino and pepper in a bowl.
Reserve a mug of pasta water. Drain spaghetti and toss with the guanciale; let the pan cool for 1 minute.
Off the heat, stir in the egg mixture quickly. Add reserved water a little at a time until glossy; serve immediately without boiling.

title: Cacio e Pepe
desc: Pecorino and black pepper emulsified with starchy pasta water.
steps: Bring water and salt to a boil in a large pot.
Cook spaghetti until just tender. Toast pepper in a dry wide pan for 30 seconds, then add a little pasta water.
Mix finely grated Pecorino with a little warm, not boiling, pasta water to make a thick paste.
Reserve more cooking water, drain spaghetti and toss in the pepper pan. Remove from the heat for 1 minute.
Toss in the cheese paste, adding warm cooking water gradually until creamy; serve immediately.

title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
desc: A simple garlic, olive oil and chilli pasta.
steps: Bring water and salt to a boil in a large pot.
Cook the pasta until just tender according to the packet. Reserve a mug of cooking water before draining.
Warm olive oil, garlic and chilli in a wide pan over low heat for 2–3 minutes until fragrant; do not let the garlic brown.
Add spaghetti and parsley. Toss vigorously with a little reserved water until the oil forms a light coating; serve immediately.

title: Bolognese
desc: A slow-simmered beef ragù for pasta and lasagne.
steps: Soften onion, carrot and celery in olive oil for 10 minutes.
Add beef and fry for 8 minutes, breaking it up until browned throughout.
Stir in tomato paste, then wine; simmer for 3 minutes.
Add tomatoes, prepared brown beef stock, milk, salt and pepper. Simmer partially covered for 90 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Weigh the sauce; reduce gently or add water to reach the displayed yield. The beef must be fully cooked, at least 71°C.

title: Lasagne
desc: Layers of pasta, beef ragù and béchamel baked until golden.
steps: Preheat to 180°C fan. Oil a deep 20 × 30 cm baking dish for the base batch.
Spread a little prepared Bolognese in the dish. Layer lasagne sheets, Bolognese and prepared béchamel, repeating until used.
Finish with béchamel and Parmesan. Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake for 15–20 minutes until the pasta is tender and the centre reaches 74°C. Rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Penne Arrabbiata
desc: Penne tossed in a spicy tomato sauce.
steps: Bring water and salt to a boil in a large pot.
Cook the pasta until just tender according to the packet. Reserve a mug of cooking water before draining.
Warm the prepared sauce gently in a saucepan; loosen with a little reserved cooking water.
Toss the hot pasta with the sauce and parsley. Add reserved cooking water as needed to coat evenly and serve immediately.

title: Pesto Pasta
desc: Pasta coated in basil pesto and Parmesan.
steps: Bring water and salt to a boil in a large pot.
Cook the pasta until just tender according to the packet. Reserve a mug of cooking water before draining.
Place the prepared sauce in a large bowl; loosen with a little reserved cooking water.
Toss the hot pasta with the sauce and Parmesan. Add reserved cooking water as needed to coat evenly and serve immediately.

title: Mac and Cheese
desc: Creamy macaroni finished on the hob.
steps: Bring water and salt to a boil in a large pot.
Cook the pasta until just tender according to the packet. Reserve a mug of cooking water before draining.
Warm the prepared sauce gently in a saucepan; loosen with a little reserved cooking water.
Toss the hot pasta with the sauce and cheddar. Add reserved cooking water as needed to coat evenly and serve immediately.

title: Fettuccine Alfredo
desc: Fettuccine coated with butter, Parmesan and pasta water.
steps: Bring water and salt to a boil in a large pot.
Cook the pasta until just tender according to the packet. Reserve a mug of cooking water before draining.
Melt butter gently in a wide pan with a little reserved pasta water, then remove from the heat.
Add hot fettuccine and gradually toss in Parmesan and pepper. Add reserved water a little at a time until creamy; serve immediately.

title: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
desc: Browned mushrooms and pasta in a Parmesan cream sauce.
steps: Bring water and salt to a boil in a large pot.
Cook the pasta until just tender according to the packet. Reserve a mug of cooking water before draining.
Fry mushrooms in butter over medium-high heat for 8–10 minutes until browned. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add cream and simmer for 3 minutes. Off the heat, stir in pasta, Parmesan, pepper and parsley; loosen with reserved water.

title: Chicken Pasta Bake
desc: Chicken and pasta baked with tomato sauce and mozzarella.
steps: Preheat to 180°C fan. Bring water and salt to a boil; cook penne for 2 minutes less than the packet time, then drain.
Heat oil in a frying pan and cook chicken for 8–10 minutes until browned and at least 74°C in the centre.
Mix pasta, chicken and prepared tomato sauce in a deep 20 × 30 cm baking dish for the base batch.
Top with mozzarella and bake for 20 minutes until bubbling and the centre reaches 74°C.

title: Pad Thai
desc: Tamarind noodles with prawns, egg and crunchy peanuts.
steps: Soak rice noodles in warm water according to the packet until flexible but still firm; drain.
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce and brown sugar.
Heat oil in a wok. Fry prawns for 2–3 minutes until opaque; add garlic for 30 seconds.
Push aside, crack in eggs and scramble until set. Add noodles and tamarind sauce; toss for 2–3 minutes until noodles are tender, adding a splash of soaking water if needed.
Fold in beansprouts and spring onions for 1 minute. Serve with peanuts and lime juice.

title: Beef Stir-Fry Noodles
desc: Beef, vegetables and noodles from the wok.
steps: Cook noodles in water according to the packet; drain, reserving a little cooking water.
Heat half the sunflower oil in a wok. Sear beef in small batches for 2–3 minutes, then set aside.
Add remaining sunflower oil, garlic and ginger for 30 seconds. Add broccoli and pepper; stir-fry for 4 minutes with a splash of reserved water.
Return beef and noodles. Add soy sauce, lime juice, honey and sesame oil; toss until hot and the beef is cooked through.

title: Garlic Sesame Noodles
desc: Quick noodles with garlic and sesame.
steps: Cook noodles according to the packet; reserve a little cooking water and drain.
Warm sunflower oil and garlic in a frying pan for 1 minute over low heat.
Mix soy sauce, sesame oil, lime juice and honey; add to the pan with the noodles.
Toss until evenly coated, adding reserved water if needed. Finish with spring onions and sesame seeds.
